fields.label: Enable FHIR Sync
fields.description: When enabled, clinical records are pushed to the FHIR server on save and pulls are allowed.

fields.label: FHIR Server URL
fields.description: Base URL of the FHIR R4 server, e.g. http://hapi:8091/fhir

fields.label: Auth Token (Bearer)
fields.description: Optional Bearer token sent in the Authorization header. Leave blank for unauthenticated servers.

fields.label: Last Pull At
fields.description: Automatically stamped after each successful pull run.

fields.label: Enable AI Case Summaries
fields.description: When enabled, AI-powered clinical summaries are generated for each Case when new observations are recorded.

fields.label: AI Provider
fields.description: Select the AI provider. Default uses the bundled Ollama container. Switch to Claude or OpenAI for managed API access.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Anthropic API key (Claude), OpenAI API key, or leave blank for unauthenticated local models.

fields.label: Base URL (Local provider)
fields.description: Bundled Ollama service: http://ollama:11434/v1. Override for LM Studio or external endpoints.

fields.label: Model Name
fields.description: Bundled default: llama3.1:8b. For Claude: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. For OpenAI: gpt-4o-mini.

fields.label: Remote Auth URL
fields.description: Legacy auth-service token-introspection endpoint, e.g. http://auth-service:8089/authenticate. Leave blank to keep the unverified local-decode fallback (dev/test only) for the X-Auth-Token mobile flow.

fields.label: Client Tag
fields.description: Value sent as the 'client' header on the remote validation call. Only affects the legacy service's own role-gating; does not affect this app's validity check.

fields.label: Minimum App Version
fields.description: System-wide minimum mobile app version, e.g. 1.4.0. Fallback when a user has no override in User App Control.

fields.label: Latest App Version
fields.description: Latest available mobile app version, e.g. 1.6.2. No per-user override exists for this value.

fields.label: Default Language
fields.description: System-level default language code (matches Flutter client locales en/bn). Fallback when no per-user override.

fields.label: AI Feature Enabled (Default)
fields.description: System-level default for mobile AI feature. Fallback when no per-user override.

fields.label: AI Widget Toggles
fields.description: Per-step on/off switches for the mobile visit flow's AI-generated widgets. Mirrors the Flutter client's AiFeatureTogglesNotifier — served to the app via controls.get_controls, no per-user override.

fields.label: Step 1: Visit Summary
fields.description: The "Before You Knock" AI briefing cards shown before symptom entry.

fields.label: Step 1: Voice Symptom Capture
fields.description: AI Scribe voice capture that pre-ticks symptom cards from what the SK says.

fields.label: Step 2: Voice Form Fill
fields.description: AI Scribe voice capture that fills the vitals and clinical assessment form.

fields.label: Step 3: Visit Summary & Recommendations
fields.description: The AI-generated visit summary, next actions, counselling, and follow-up plan.

fields.label: Step 3: Danger Sign / Referral Alert
fields.description: The alert card that flags danger signs and recommends a referral.

fields.label: Step 3: WhatsApp Draft
fields.description: The pre-written WhatsApp message summarising the visit for the patient.

fields.label: VAD Gate Tuning
fields.description: Realtime-ASR voice-activity-detection gate thresholds — saves mobile data by not streaming silence. Mirrors the Flutter client's VadTuningNotifier/AppConfig.vad* defaults.

fields.label: Entry Margin (dB)
fields.description: dB above the noise floor required to start treating audio as speech.

fields.label: Sustain Margin (dB)
fields.description: Lower bar used to stay in speech mode once started.

fields.label: Noise Floor Ceiling (dBFS)
fields.description: Caps how high the background-noise estimate is allowed to climb in a loud room.

fields.label: Noise Floor Adaptation Speed
fields.description: How quickly the background-noise estimate adapts to the room.

fields.label: Startup Calibration Window (ms)
fields.description: How long at the start of a recording is assumed silent, to measure the room's baseline noise.

fields.label: Speech Confirmation Window (ms)
fields.description: How long a sound must stay above the entry threshold before it's confirmed as real speech.

fields.label: Trailing Silence Window (ms)
fields.description: How long to keep recording after volume drops, to bridge a natural pause.

fields.label: Pre-Speech Buffer (ms)
fields.description: How much audio just before speech is confirmed gets included anyway.
